chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from al-Sulayman ibn Dawud, who said: I heard more than one of our companions narrating from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:

The son of Adam will not do a deed greater in the sight of God, the Blessed and Exalted, than a man who kills a Prophet or an Imam, or destroys the Ka'ba which God, the Mighty and Majestic, made as the Qibla for His worship, or pours his semen into a woman (illegitimately).
ai.seo_question: What are the three greatest deeds of man near God according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq highlights these three acts as the 'worst' (ashadd al-darar) due to their destruction of the fundamental pillars of worship and authority: the Prophet/Imam as the guide, the Ka'ba as the physical qibla, and zina as the corruption of lineage. This classification underscores the Shia emphasis on the continuity of divine guidance through the Imams, equating their spiritual status with that of the Prophets in terms of reverence and the gravity of their removal.
